markdown:
# QA rounds, patient feedback and health education

| Source | What the surveyor checks | Haspataal |
|---|---|---|
| Clinic indicator 17 (PDF p47-50) | The in-charge checks the facilities and services periodically on a checklist, dated, signed and kept in record | The QA rounds: `POST /qa/rounds`, `GET /qa/rounds/{id}/pdf` |
| Clinic indicator 18 (PDF p47-48) | A written record of the actions taken on the observations | `POST /qa/rounds/{id}/actions`, `POST /patient-feedback/{id}/actions`: the action register |
| Clinic indicator 25 (PDF p57) | Health messages and IEC material displayed or available, and consistent evidence that patients are guided | `/education/materials`, `POST /patients/{id}/education`, `GET /education/register` |
| Clinic indicator 45 and Annex A (PDF p97, p111) | Client feedback on a simple format during the visit; its use to improve the system | `POST /patient-feedback`, the review, the summary |

Who: the **Quality Officer**, the **Owner** and the **Hospital Admin** run the rounds (`qa.round.conduct`), keep the
checklist (`qa.checklist.manage`) and the education materials (`education.manage`) and review the feedback
(`feedback.review`); **Reception** records feedback (`feedback.record`); **doctors**, **nurses** and the
**pharmacist** record the education they give (`education.give`).

## 1. QA rounds (Quality Officer, Owner)

1. `GET /qa/rounds/status`: one card per checklist, `is_due` when it was never done or the interval has passed.
2. `GET /qa/checklist-items?frequency=DailyWeekly`: the 15 daily/weekly items of the manual's form (13
   monthly/quarterly: its first monthly item has three parts), plus the establishment's own.
3. `POST /qa/rounds` with an `Idempotency-Key`:

   ```json
   {"frequency": "DailyWeekly", "conducted_at": "2026-10-14T09:30:00+05:00",
    "items": [{"item_id": 1, "result": "Satisfactory"},
              {"item_id": 9, "result": "NeedsAttention", "observation": "Cylinder half empty",
               "recommendation": "Refill weekly"}],
    "general_remarks": "Clean; oxygen low"}
   ```

   Every active item of the frequency must be answered once (`VALIDATION_ERROR` with `missing_item_ids` /
   `unknown_item_ids`); NeedsAttention needs the observation. The round is signed with the in-charge's stamp and kept
   as signed.
4. `POST /qa/rounds/{id}/actions` for each finding to act on (`action_type`, `description`, `owner_user_id`,
   `due_date`); it appears in `GET /quality/actions?source=QaRound`.
   An action's department comes from `GET /admin/departments`.
5. `GET /qa/rounds/{id}/pdf`: the form filled in, for the record.

Checklist items: `POST /qa/checklist-items` (`QA_CHECKLIST_ITEM_EXISTS` for a code in use),
`PATCH /qa/checklist-items/{id}` (reword, reorder, `is_active: false` to retire; `expected_version`).

### The quarterly inspection of the medicine storage

The third checklist, `StorageQuarterly`, is the written record the clinic manual asks of the technical in-charge every
quarter (indicator 36's guideline, PDF p80-81): its eleven safe storage practices and the line on emergency medicines
(Emergency Box, Crash Carts), seeded with their source. It works like the other rounds
(`GET /qa/checklist-items?frequency=StorageQuarterly`, `POST /qa/rounds {"frequency": "StorageQuarterly", ...}`), is
due again after `qa_round_storage_days` (92) and prints as "Drug storage site inspection". The Category II C manual's
four further practices (p225: the patient's own medicines, special storage conditions, returns to the pharmacy, the
medication room locked) are seeded inactive with their source: a II C hospital switches them on with
`PATCH /qa/checklist-items/{item_id} {"is_active": true}` (`GET /qa/checklist-items?include_inactive=true`).

## 2. Patient feedback (Reception; Quality Officer, Owner)

1. `POST /patient-feedback` with an `Idempotency-Key`: `channel` (ExitInterview, Form, KeyInformant), `respondent`
   (Patient, Relative, Anonymous, CommunityMember), `satisfied`, `reasons` from the list of that answer, `other_reason`
   with Other, `comments`, `received_on`; `ticket_id` only when the respondent agrees to be named.
   A named respondent's patient from `GET /patients/search`; the visit of an exit interview from today's queue,
   `GET /opd-queues/reception-dashboard`.

   If satisfied, "how?":

1. `CompleteInformation`: Complete information provided
2. `AvailableWhenNeeded`: Services available when needed
3. `NotCostly`: Services are not costly
4. `ConvenientToReach`: Convenient to reach the facility
5. `CourteousStaff`: Staff is courteous
6. `RelevantStaffAvailable`: Relevant staff is available
7. `PrivacyObserved`: Privacy is observed
8. `FemaleStaffAvailable`: Female staff is available
9. `Recovered`: I recovered after treatment
10. `Other`: Other (specify)

   If not, "why?":

1. `Confidentiality`: Issues of confidentiality
2. `Privacy`: Issues of privacy
3. `LackOfAttention`: Lack of attention
4. `InadequateInformation`: Inadequate information provided
5. `AskedToComeAgain`: I was asked to come another time
6. `Costly`: Medicines/services are costly
7. `LongWait`: Waiting time is too long
8. `DiscourteousStaff`: Staff is discourteous / unsatisfactory behaviour
9. `StaffNotCompetent`: Staff is not competent
10. `RelevantStaffNotAvailable`: Relevant staff not available
11. `FemaleStaffNotAvailable`: Female staff not available (gender issue)
12. `SideEffects`: I suffered from side effects of the treatment
13. `Other`: Other (specify)
2. `GET /patient-feedback/form/pdf`: blank forms for the suggestion box.
3. Review: `GET /patient-feedback?review_pending=true`, then `POST /patient-feedback/{id}/review
   {"action_taken"}` once (`FEEDBACK_ALREADY_REVIEWED`), and `POST /patient-feedback/{id}/actions` for a change.
   An action's department comes from `GET /admin/departments`.
4. `GET /patient-feedback/summary?date_from=&date_to=`: counts by answer and by reason, still to review, actions raised.

## 3. Health education (doctor, nurse; Quality Officer)

1. Materials: `GET /education/materials`, `POST /education/materials` (`EDUCATION_MATERIAL_EXISTS` for a title in use),
   `PATCH /education/materials/{id}`.
2. In the consultation or the chart: `POST /patients/{patient_id}/education` with an `Idempotency-Key`:
   `{"topic", "method", "given_to", "material_id", "encounter_id", "note"}`. A Leaflet or Video names its material;
   a retired material answers `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND`. `GET /patients/{patient_id}/education` lists them.
3. `GET /education/register?date_from=&date_to=`: the evidence for the surveyor; every row read is logged.
